desc: Derive and validate the fixed-length weighted interval-selection DP, including proof that exactly k windows suffices.
Design and validate the O(n log n) coordinate-compressed Fenwick-tree computation of every length-x window median-equalization cost.
Integrate the window-cost computation and DP into the required Python implementation with complexity analysis.
Verify the complete implementation on examples and edge cases (overlapping cheap windows, duplicates, negatives, and x=2).
